吴姜盘腿坐在床头，双目微阖，胸前的银色吊坠正缓缓散发着温润的灵气，这吊坠被他取名为聚灵吊坠，连日来全靠它的辅助，他的魂力凝练速度比以往快了数倍。

他能清晰地感觉到，体内的魂力已经充盈到了临界点，距离鬼卒境只有一步之遥，那层瓶颈仿佛一触即破。

得益于老妈王雅琴的逼迫，吴姜最近正在考察，准备自己开一家小店。

他既然不想给别人打工，那摆在他面前的只有两条路了。

一个是去老爹的店铺打杂学习，等着以后继承老爹的“墨香居”。第二个就是开一家自己喜欢的店铺了。

就在他心思飘远，琢磨着开家什么店合适时，心神悸动又来了。

他不急不慢地睁开眼，熟练的召出阴差令牌，吴姜下意识以为，又有新的任务派发下来了。

伸指一点，却发现这次不是来了新任务，而是一条别的消息。

“三等鬼差吴姜，协助苍名县城隍庙抓捕厉鬼，任务结算完成，奖励贡献点50点。”

吴姜看着奖励的贡献点数，嘴角忍不住抽了抽，心里默默吐槽：地府也太抠门了吧？

吐槽归吐槽，他还是阅读起了厉鬼的详细信息。

【厉鬼信息】：赵芳雅，死于中华民国二十五年（1936年），死因：为情自缢，死后灵魂执念不散，附于生前陪葬品吊坠之上；后该吊坠被盗墓贼盗出，几经辗转，被苍名县王寻购得。赵芳雅死后未害一人性命，只因王寻与她情人很像，这才纠缠王家，才引发后续祸端。

吴姜咂舌，这没害过人性命都这么厉害了，要是她大开杀戒过后，不知道得凶到什么程度。

阅读完厉鬼信息，吴姜又进入了空间内，看到自己的贡献点数已经到了120点了。

吴姜顺手打开兑换中心，翻了一圈，发现以自己目前的贡献点，能买得起的只有些基础符箓、简易驱邪道具等等。

对于他这种身负《幽冥炼魂诀》这种高级修炼功法的人来说，这些基础玩意儿，压根提不起一丝兴趣，纯属鸡肋。

吴姜撇了撇嘴，正准备退出去，令牌轻震了一下，这次来的真的是新任务了。

Chapter 20 Intermediate Mission - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of God"

Wu Jiang sat cross-legged on the bedside, his eyes slightly closed, and the silver pendant on his chest was slowly exuding warm spiritual energy. He named this pendant the Spirit-Gathering Pendant. With its help in recent days, his soul power was condensing several times faster than before.

He could clearly feel that the soul power in his body had been filled to the critical point. He was only one step away from the ghost soldier realm, and the bottleneck seemed to be broken at the touch of a touch.

Thanks to the pressure from his mother Wang Yaqin, Wu Jiang is currently investigating and preparing to open a small store of his own.

Since he doesn't want to work for others, there are only two options before him.

One is to go to his father's shop to work as a miscellaneous student, waiting to inherit his father's "Moxiangju" in the future.The second is to open a store that you like.

Just when his mind was wandering, wondering what kind of store would be suitable to open, his heart palpitations came again.

He opened his eyes slowly and skillfully summoned the evil token. Wu Jiang subconsciously thought that a new mission had been assigned.

Stretching his finger, he discovered that this time it was not a new mission, but a different message.

"Wu Jiang, a third-class ghost officer, assisted the Town God's Temple in Cangming County to capture the fierce ghosts. The task was completed and the reward was 50 contribution points."

Wu Jiang looked at the rewarded contribution points and couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth, silently complaining in his heart: Is the underworld too stingy?

Complaints aside, he still read the detailed information about Li Gui.

[Information about ghosts]: Zhao Fangya died in the 25th year of the Republic of China (1936). Cause of death: Hanging herself for love. After death, her soul persisted and was attached to the pendant that was buried with her during her lifetime. Later, the pendant was stolen by tomb robbers. After several rounds, it was purchased by the king of Cangming County.Zhao Fangya died without killing anyone. It was only because Wang Xun was very similar to her lover that she entangled the Wang family and caused subsequent troubles.

Wu Jiang smacked his tongue, this was so terrible that it had never harmed anyone's life. If she went on a killing spree, she didn't know how cruel she would be.

After reading Li Gui's information, Wu Jiang entered the space again and saw that his contribution points had reached 120 points.

Wu Jiang opened the exchange center and looked around, finding that with his current contribution points, the only things he could afford were basic talismans, simple exorcism props, etc.

For someone like him who has advanced cultivation techniques such as "Netherworld Soul Refining Technique", these basic gadgets cannot arouse any interest at all and are purely useless.

Wu Jiang curled his lips and was about to exit when the token vibrated slightly. It was really a new mission this time.
